flat.example: The flat is close to the station.

contrasts.example: Place the cup on a flat surface.
contrasts.exampleZh: 把杯子放在一个平坦的表面上。

contrasts.example: We had a flat on the motorway.
contrasts.exampleZh: 我们在高速公路上遇到了轮胎瘪掉的情况。

deposit.example: The landlord asked for a deposit before handing over the keys.

contrasts.example: She made a deposit into her savings account.
contrasts.exampleZh: 她往自己的储蓄账户存了一笔钱。

contrasts.example: She deposits part of her salary every month.
contrasts.exampleZh: 她每月存下一部分工资。

deposit.exampleZh: 房东要求在交钥匙前支付押金。

charges.example: Are there any extra charges for heating?

contrasts.example: I need to charge my phone before leaving.
contrasts.exampleZh: 我出门前需要给手机充电。

condition.example: Please record the condition of the window before I move in.

contrasts.example: The lease includes a condition about repairs.
contrasts.exampleZh: 租约包含一项有关维修的条件。

contrasts.example: She has a heart condition.
contrasts.exampleZh: 她患有心脏疾病。

condition.exampleZh: 请在我搬入前记录窗户的状况。

viewing.note: 这里是英式租房语境中的“看房”。WordNet 3.0 收录了 viewing 的其他意思，却没有这一具体用法；请用剑桥词典链接核对。
viewing.example: Could we arrange a viewing on Saturday?
viewing.exampleZh: 我们能预约星期六看房吗？

contrasts.example: The agent is available after six.
contrasts.exampleZh: 中介六点以后有空。

available.exampleZh: 这套公寓现在还可以租吗？

shift.example: Her work shift ends at nine.

contrasts.example: There was a shift in local housing demand.
contrasts.exampleZh: 当地住房需求发生了变化。

shift.exampleZh: 她的工作班次九点结束。

fault.example: The tap has a fault that makes it leak.

contrasts.example: The leak is not your fault.
contrasts.exampleZh: 漏水不是你的责任。

fault.exampleZh: 水龙头有个故障，导致它漏水。

tap.example: The tap under the sink is leaking.

contrasts.example: Tap the screen to open the map.
contrasts.exampleZh: 轻点屏幕以打开地图。

tap.exampleZh: 水槽下方的水龙头正在漏水。

furnished.example: The furnished flat has a sofa and a table.

contrasts.example: They furnished the room with a desk.
contrasts.exampleZh: 他们给房间配了一张书桌。

furnished.exampleZh: 这套带家具的公寓有一个沙发和一张桌子。

route.example: The bus route goes past the station.
route.exampleZh: 这条公交线路经过车站。

budget.exampleZh: 我的每月住房预算是900英镑。

studio.example: The studio has a small kitchen beside the living area.
studio.exampleZh: 这间单间公寓的起居区域旁有一个小厨房。

contrasts.example: She teaches drawing in her studio.
contrasts.exampleZh: 她在自己的工作室里教绘画。

suburb.example: She lives in a suburb and takes the train to work.
suburb.exampleZh: 她住在郊区，乘火车上班。

commute.example: Her daily commute takes forty minutes.
commute.exampleZh: 她每天的通勤需要四十分钟。

enquire.example: I called to enquire about the flat.
enquire.exampleZh: 我打电话咨询这套公寓。

appointment.example: I have an appointment with the estate agent at six.
appointment.exampleZh: 我约了六点与房产中介见面。

contrasts.example: The appointment of a new manager was announced today.
contrasts.exampleZh: 今天公布了对新经理的任命。

address.example: Could you confirm the full address of the flat?
address.exampleZh: 你能确认这套公寓的完整地址吗？

confirm.example: Please confirm the viewing time by email.
confirm.exampleZh: 请用电子邮件确认看房时间。

cosy.example: The little living room feels cosy in the evening.
cosy.exampleZh: 晚上，这个小客厅让人感到舒适温馨。

damp.example: The kitchen wall is damp near the window.
damp.exampleZh: 厨房窗边的墙有些潮湿。

landlord.example: The landlord agreed to arrange a repair.

spacious.example: The second flat is more spacious, but the commute is longer.
spacious.exampleZh: 第二套公寓更宽敞，但通勤路程更长。

noise.example: Traffic noise makes it difficult to sleep.
noise.exampleZh: 交通噪声让人难以入睡。

payment.example: When is the first payment due?
payment.exampleZh: 第一笔款项什么时候到期？

utility.example: Utility bills are not included in the rent.
utility.exampleZh: 租金不包括水电等公用事业费用。

bills.example: She checks her electricity bills every month.

contrasts.example: Parliament debated the new housing bill.
contrasts.exampleZh: 议会讨论了新的住房法案。

inventory.example: The inventory lists the furniture in the flat.
inventory.exampleZh: 物品清单列出了公寓内的家具。
inventory.note: WordNet 的这一名词义项侧重库存清单，未单列租房交接中的物品与状况清单。本项目情境义是“交接物品清单”，请结合下方学习者词典核对。

keys.example: The agent handed over the keys on moving day.
keys.exampleZh: 中介在搬入当天交了钥匙。

pack.example: Pack the books in a separate box.
pack.exampleZh: 把书装进一个单独的箱子。

storeroom.example: She put the empty boxes in the storeroom.
storeroom.exampleZh: 她把空箱子放进了储藏室。

assemble.example: We need to assemble the desk before using it.
assemble.exampleZh: 我们需要先组装书桌才能使用。

contrasts.example: The students assembled outside the library.
contrasts.exampleZh: 学生们在图书馆外集合。

replacement.example: Could you send a replacement screw?
replacement.exampleZh: 你能寄一颗替换用的螺丝吗？

leaking.example: The tap is leaking beneath the sink.
leaking.exampleZh: 水槽下方的水龙头在漏水。

report.example: I need to report a fault in the kitchen tap.
report.exampleZh: 我需要报告厨房水龙头的一个故障。

plumber.example: The plumber will check the leaking pipe on Friday.
plumber.exampleZh: 水管工星期五会检查漏水的管道。

repair.example: Could you arrange a repair before I move in?
repair.exampleZh: 你能在我搬入之前安排维修吗？

contrasts.example: The plumber repaired the tap.
contrasts.exampleZh: 水管工修好了水龙头。

cycle.example: She cycles to work when the weather is good.
cycle.exampleZh: 天气好时她骑自行车上班。

timetable.example: Check the train timetable before leaving home.
timetable.exampleZh: 出门前核对一下火车时刻表。

reliable.example: She needs a reliable way to get to work on time.
reliable.exampleZh: 她需要一种可靠的通勤方式，让自己准时上班。

delayed.example: The bus was delayed by roadworks.
delayed.exampleZh: 公交车因道路施工晚点了。

directions.example: Could you give me directions to the station?
directions.exampleZh: 你能告诉我去车站怎么走吗？

direction.example: Which direction should I walk in?

fare.example: The bus fare is lower than the train fare.

contrasts.example: How did you fare in the interview?
contrasts.exampleZh: 你在面试中表现如何？

fare.exampleZh: 公交车费比火车票价低。

lease.example: She read the lease before signing it.

contrasts.example: The owner leased the flat to a student.
contrasts.exampleZh: 房主把公寓租给了一名学生。

lease.exampleZh: 她在签字前阅读了租约。

contract.example: She checked the contract before paying the deposit.

contrasts.example: Metal contracts as it cools.
contrasts.exampleZh: 金属冷却时会收缩。

contract.exampleZh: 她在支付押金前核对了合同。

uses.note: WordNet 的名词释义主要指候选人名单；这里是房源候选清单，请通过学习者词典核对更广的用法。
uses.example: She added two flats to her shortlist.
uses.exampleZh: 她把两套公寓列入了候选短名单。

uses.example: We will shortlist two suitable flats.
uses.exampleZh: 我们会挑选两套合适的公寓列入候选。

uses.example: The water caused damage to the cupboard.
The leaking water may damage the cupboard.
uses.exampleZh: 漏出来的水可能损坏橱柜。
